reviews.x: This is my full honest review. I been looking for a good beard comb for the past few months and stumbled upon AleHorn and thought I check out the beard comb. I've had a beard for a few years and have always used a cheap plastic comb and thought it worked fine. I came across an article about how plastic combs electrify your beard and create stray hairs. So I did some looking around and came across this comb and thought it was not only a good deal, but why not release my inner Viking and use a han

When I first placed my order for a Beard Comb through AleHorn, I wasn't sure what to expect. I like their products, but wasn't sure if they had quality products other than what their namesake suggested. However, I'm glad that I went ahead and placed that order. You see, I have a rather large and bushy beard which tends to take a bit of work to get under control. The comb I normally use gets the initial job done, but then I spend a long time brushing it to get the look I want. I was able to simpl

reviews.t: Highly doubt the one star rating is correct, mine ...
reviews.x: Highly doubt the one star rating is correct, mine seems to be made of actual horn due to the scent, and lack of molding marks that plastic would have. One tooth is cut thin (i dont care), it works well and doesnt rip hairs out or cause stray hairs. I will be buying more as gifts.

reviews.t: Two combs, one 5 stars, one 1 star
reviews.x: I bought two, one for home and one for work.  The home one is great- best comb I have ever owned, by far.  Works great for the beard, and I end up using it on my hair as well.  The one at work smells awful.  I let it sit for a while to air out, but that didn't help.  I washed it repeatedly, but that didn't help.  On one side, the surface isn't smooth - it looks like half of that side of the comb was gouged.  The good comb is smooth on both sides.  This one smells strongly like rotting fecal mate

Okay, I just got this thing in. I was sceptical when I purchased this, but everyone who has a beard needs this comb!! It will do wonders for your beard. I never really thought a plastic comb was that bad and that it really statically charged my beard but wow this comb makes it much better!!
Very well made product, but I have a short beard. This is definitely made for a fuller and thicker beard.

reviews.t: I love how unique and rustic this comb is
reviews.x: I love how unique and rustic this comb is. I received it quickly and on time and was impressed with it immediately. I am always happy to use a natural product over plastic whenever possible and it works great. My beard doesn't get staticky and it feels great. As with all horn combs, it takes a little time for the natural oils in my hair and the beard oils and balms I use to overcome the smell of horn so definitely don't use it in a wet beard or wet hair until it is "broken in". Also, bec

reviews.t: Not good. Snags and pulls hair.
reviews.x: I'm afraid I'm going to have to give this one star. The problem is the teeth are textured on one side. There are little cuts and scratches in it and it snags and pulls the hair out of my beard. Maybe this one is defective; I don't know. As you can see by the pics, one side is smooth and the other side is textured. That's fine, but the teeth should be smooth all the way around as to not snag hair.  Edit: May 30 2018.  The comb broke. No idea why. I pulled it out of my pocket and it was broke.

Ornate comb that meet my expectations, every comb seems to have its own individual finish which was a plus in my book. It is nice to know that I have something in this world that no one else has! All in all the comb seems functional, and durable. I have used the comb in my bathroom for a while and it seems superior to products made available in the stores. I am a user of the company's other products and the comb is easily on par with the drinking horns!

reviews.t: Beautiful, but think twice if you have a thick beard.
reviews.x: This comb is definitely real, and mine had good color and marbling. It probably works well for fine beards. But It does not do much in my really coarse beard. I think that's because the spaces between the teeth are very narrow, narrower than what is typically found on a "little black comb". Because they're so narrow, it pulls and snags a bit. This comb would be 5 stars if it worked well for course beards.

I ordered this because I lost my mustache comb. It came and I was surprised to find it is a regular sized comb. I was expecting a small pocket sized comb.  It is about 5 inches long as it states in the description that I didn't read. It would work with a large full beard but I do not have one. It is not very fine toothed either but it is hand made so I can see why.

reviews.t: It seems to be of high quality. I am ...
reviews.x: It seems to be of high quality. I am careful with it because of hearing about how delicate they are, but no issues here so far. As far as beard/mustache use it seemed a little large. I prefer a brush for my hair length. It does work well on my head though. Maybe one day the beard will be long enough to really use this. :)

reviews.t: My original comb was a pretty skunky [I've mostly weeded that smell out with my ...
reviews.x: Have to appreciate a company committed to customer satisfaction. My original comb was a pretty skunky [I've mostly weeded that smell out with my beard oils, but not all the way yet]; but they're sending a new one to replace it. Comb-wise i have no complaints and definitely appreciate its ability to absorb new smells.

I bought this for my husband. He absolutely loves it. There was one minor issue on one of the times that caused hair to be pulled. But after speaking with Alehorn customer service, that has been taken care of. There isn't a better company on the planet to deal with. I love these guys and gals.

A little bigger than I first expected. Was planning on using this as more of a pocket/travel comb, but it's now become my main comb for at home and I absolutely love it. Excellent design and beautiful character.  Just be careful leaving it around. My dog has been eyeing it since day one.

reviews.t: This one is just as good quality and the color is awesome
reviews.x: My dog ate the last horn comb I had. This one is just as good quality and the color is awesome. Solid black on one side and the other is a mix of creams, yellows and oranges. I know the colors are never the same but this one is great. I'll have to keep this one out of reach of the dogs.

I like the combs. They are thick and don't feel fragile. I believe a plastic comb with the same thickness/dimensions would bend or crack if you accidentally sat on it in your pocket. The natural coloring is more pleasant to look at than painted plastic too.

Awesome beard comb! I've used several different ones on the market (plastics, wood and metal) but this one stands out for me. If you're starting to get some length on your mustache/beard or even your regular hair give this comb a chance!

I waited awhile before ordering one of these combs,i don't know why I waited. I am very impressed with the quality,size,flex and it does distribute the oil/balm well. I think I'm going to buy a few more just to give away to friends.

reviews.t: My husband loved it. feels great
reviews.x: My husband loved it. feels great, not cheap, he said he could tell a difference when using it compaired to a regular comb. He would use it after his beard oil. Would make a nice gift! We would def recommend this to a friend!

didnt really like these, just went with a regular comb for my beard, couldn't get over how much it smelled and the rough texture, the teeth could be rounded a bit, they were just jagged edges that irritated my skin.

The comb is pretty great!  Doesn't break/snag/split the hairs like plastic combs or simply break like wooden combs. I did have a problem with my first comb and their customer service was excellent to work with.

reviews.t: Thought I was purchasing a nice beard comb for my husband
reviews.x: Product is completely misrepresented.  Thought I was purchasing a nice beard comb for my husband.  What I got was 100/% pure PLASTIC.  Keep looking or go to the dollar tree, quality will be the same.
It does the job well to detangle all my beard hair. My beard feels no static when combing through. It did a good job on my mustache. My beard and mustache looks much better after use
It is the most excellent comb that I've had for my beard. No snag, no static, looks good, sturdy, and comfortable to use. Would definitely recommend it to serious beard groomers.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the comb's quality and effectiveness, calling it the best comb they've owned and noting it reduces static compared to plastic.
Many appreciate the unique, rustic, natural horn appearance and individual finish of each comb.
Some reviewers report the comb snags or pulls hair, sometimes due to textured or rough teeth, though customer service resolved some cases.
Several note the comb is larger than expected and better suited to full, thick beards than short or fine ones.
A few mention an unpleasant smell from the horn material, which in some cases led to a replacement.
